learning_outcomes.text: Students know the mechanical behavior of materials.
They know the most important material testing methods and the characteristic values determined with them.
Students can interpret measurement results of the respective material testing methods and relate them to the correlating material properties.

With the broad knowledge of testing methods, students can independently apply them to solve complex problems in material development, component design, quality assurance, as well as reliability and damage analysis of components.

syllabus_topics: Static and dynamic material testing methods
teaching_methods: Practical training (laboratory sessions) in small groups
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, students must pass the module examination. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by the credit points.
bibliography: Alle Unterlagen (Skript, Laborunterlagen, usw.) werden digital über die E-Learning-Plattform zur Verfügung gestellt. Die Sekundärliteratur ist als E-Book verfügbar: Bargel, H.J. und G. Schulze: Werkstoffkunde, Springer Verlag Berlin
